add-column: Nullable fallback identity columns have no defaults and rewrite no existing decision rows. ACCESS EXCLUSIVE covers catalog changes under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
replace-view: Appending the fallback identity columns refreshes the existing published and unredacted view projections without changing their row predicates or scanning stored decisions. Catalog locks are bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-table-references: The new alias table is empty, so its source foreign key validates no existing rows. Referenced-table locks are bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: RLS is enabled on the new empty alias table before its ingestion grant. The metadata-only change is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-policy: The ingestion policy is installed on the new empty alias table before privileges are granted; catalog work is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
